title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment
description: This is a task resource allowing assessment of the risks associated with a party or party role that considers acquiring a specific product offering (TM Forum TMF696 Risk Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment:<tmfId>. unique identifier

status.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/status'. The status of the risk assessment, such as Succeeded, In Progress, Failed, output from the task

characteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/characteristic'. Additional characteristics for which the risk might be assessed, optional input to the task

partyRole.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/partyRole'. The party or party role for which the assessment is to be carried out, must be supplied as input to the task, with the attribute id populated

place.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/place'. The place for which the risk is assessed, this is optional input to the task

productOffering.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PartyRoleProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/productOffering'. The product offering for which the assessment is to be carried out, must be supplied as input to the task, with the attribute id populated. In TMF this is a ProductOfferingRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ProductOffering entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOffering:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

The result of the risk assessment, output from the task
